description: CRIT-003 and PROP-006 require executable boundary behavior, but all 12 poll/deadline cases are source-text regex assertions. They do not advance a clock, execute production polling, observe delays, prove cancellation, or prove that the final allowed attempt succeeds; constants and comments can satisfy these tests without the required runtime behavior.

evidence.snippet: const cases = [[... /for \(let index = 0; index < 6/ ...], ...]; ... assert.match(target, pattern);
